title: Comprehensive Transcriptomic Analysis of Mouse Gonadal Development
author: Wang, Tian, et al.
materials: Total RNA was isolated from the gonads of 12.5, 13.5 and 16.5 dpc and 6 dpp mice using TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. An Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, USA) was used to measure total RNA quantity and assess RNA integrity.

steps.title: Set up timed matings
steps.instruction: Place one male mouse together with two female mice in a cage; the next morning check each female for a vaginal plug and record the day of plug detection as 0.5 days post coitum (dpc).

steps.title: Collect and freeze gonads
steps.instruction: Euthanize pregnant females at the desired gestational ages (12.5, 13.5, 16.5 dpc) using carbon dioxide, dissect embryonic gonads free of the mesonephros, snap‑freeze them in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C. Also collect gonads from 6‑day‑post‑partum (6 dpp) mice, immediately freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the frozen gonads of 12.5, 13.5, 16.5 dpc and 6 dpp samples using TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, Waltham, MA, USA) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and evaluate integrity with an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, USA).

steps.title: Identify differentially expressed genes
steps.instruction: Analyze the RNA‑seq data with the DESeq package in R (Version 1.36.0); designate genes as differentially expressed when the fold change (FC) ≥ 2 and the false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.05.

steps.title: Perform series‑cluster analysis
steps.instruction: Run the Series‑Cluster analysis of DEGs using the STEM method (http://www.cs.cmu.edu/~jernst/st/); determine significant expression profiles with Fisher’s exact test and multiple‑comparison correction.

steps.title: Construct WGCNA network
steps.instruction: Create a weighted gene co‑expression network with the WGCNA R package (Version 1.68): compute pairwise Pearson correlations of expression values, transform them to an adjacency matrix using a power function to achieve scale‑free topology, calculate the topological overlap measure (TOM) from the adjacency matrix, and cluster genes into modules based on TOM similarity.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of results
steps.instruction: For each experimental group, perform three independent replicates; express data as mean ± SEM; analyze with ANOVA followed by Fisher’s least‑significant‑difference test using R (Version 3.5.1); consider differences significant when p < 0.05.
